note: Authoritative device matrix, advanced to the consolidated Phase 4 candidate. No physical results supplied; automated/macOS/Chromium checks do not upgrade these rows. Build 14 includes Phase 2 and Phase 3 native changes.

tests.conditions: Fresh install, then saved dark preference and restart
tests.expectedBehaviour: Approved full-bleed purple icon; splash; light default; saved preference retained; onboarding/auth works
tests.reproductionSteps: Inspect Home Screen; open build 13; complete onboarding; select dark; restart; record screenshots.

tests.conditions: Smallest available iPhone; default and largest text
tests.expectedBehaviour: No clipped controls; accessible player and settings
tests.reproductionSteps: Open player/settings/onboarding with default then largest supported text; capture screens.

tests.conditions: Wi-Fi then cellular; cold and warm episode
tests.expectedBehaviour: Immediate ordinary playback independent of optional AI; controls share one player
tests.reproductionSteps: Record screen plus audible output from Play to first sound; pause/resume/seek; use mini and full player; switch episode; record measured startup seconds.

tests.conditions: Start playback; disable network; reconnect
tests.expectedBehaviour: Buffered audio behaves honestly; retry recovers; position preserved
tests.reproductionSteps: Interrupt network during playback, note buffer exhaustion/error; reconnect/retry and compare position.

tests.conditions: Podcast playing; foreground another app for five minutes
tests.expectedBehaviour: Audio continues; position consistent with elapsed time and speed
tests.reproductionSteps: Record start/end position and times, battery, any interruption; use available Instruments memory data only if measured.

tests.conditions: Podcast playing; lock for five minutes
tests.expectedBehaviour: Continuous audio and position continuity
tests.reproductionSteps: Record start/end positions and clock, speed and interruptions; unlock and compare.

tests.conditions: Locked phone, then headphones/Bluetooth where available
tests.expectedBehaviour: Play/pause/seek/title/artwork/position correct; speed preserved
tests.reproductionSteps: At 1.5x use lock-screen play/pause/seek both ways; repeat headset controls; compare app state.

tests.conditions: Private pilot; owned hash-verified fixture; Ad Skip enabled
tests.expectedBehaviour: 15–35s break seeks to verified end; playback continues; Undo restores origin
tests.reproductionSteps: Search accurate evidence playback in All Processed Podcasts; open owned fixture; enable Ad Skip; reload verified source; play before break; record actual origin/end/Undo positions.

tests.conditions: Same verified fixture; screen locked then background
tests.expectedBehaviour: Only verified interval may seek; record actual behaviour even if JS suspension prevents skip
tests.reproductionSteps: Repeat break once locked and once backgrounded; unlock immediately for Undo; capture timings and server events.

tests.conditions: Same verified fixture; both speeds
tests.expectedBehaviour: Confirmed seek/Undo preserves speed and state
tests.reproductionSteps: Reload each run; set speed; play break and Undo; record positions and resulting speed.

tests.conditions: Same verified fixture
tests.expectedBehaviour: No unsafe stale automatic seek; paused playback stays paused; Undo remains safe
tests.reproductionSteps: Seek into break; pause; resume; repeat Undo while paused; record transitions.

tests.conditions: Same verified fixture
tests.expectedBehaviour: Stale operation cannot seek new episode; route loss does not resume unexpectedly
tests.reproductionSteps: Switch episode near boundary; repeat with Bluetooth disconnect and network loss; record event sequence.

tests.feature: Expired lease and incorrect skip report
tests.conditions: Controlled expired/invalid proof; private pilot only
tests.expectedBehaviour: No unauthorised seek; report records genuine feedback
tests.reproductionSteps: Engineering-controlled expired lease case without weakening server gates; attempt skip; submit test-labelled report only for actual observation.

tests.conditions: Playing episode; shortest supported AI observation; locked
tests.expectedBehaviour: Fade then pause near native deadline; recovery and saved position correct
tests.reproductionSteps: Note predicted deadline; lock; independently time audible fade/pause; unlock, record saved/recovery position; export diagnostics if future build supports them.

tests.conditions: Playing episode; five-minute timer; lock
tests.expectedBehaviour: Audible fade and one pause; persisted correct position
tests.reproductionSteps: Record start/deadline/actual fade/pause times externally; unlock and restart; compare saved position.

tests.conditions: Manual timer active then cancel or switch episode
tests.expectedBehaviour: No stale fade/pause on new source; volume restored
tests.reproductionSteps: Cancel during fade; repeat switching source; wait beyond old deadline; verify continued intended playback.

tests.conditions: AI Sleep active; extend successively and during fade
tests.expectedBehaviour: Only latest deadline pauses; new deadline persisted; no stale fade
tests.reproductionSteps: Record deadline before/after each extension; rapid repeat; lock and observe final audible pause.

tests.conditions: AI/manual timer active; exercise each available route
tests.expectedBehaviour: Interrupted/cancelled timer cannot auto-resume or affect another source
tests.reproductionSteps: Receive call; remove headphones; disconnect Bluetooth; repeat manual pause; record state before/after old deadline.

tests.conditions: Armed/fading then force quit; AI/manual precedence
tests.expectedBehaviour: Interrupted state on restart; no stale deadline; one shared timer
tests.reproductionSteps: Replace AI with manual and vice versa; force quit/reopen; select another episode; wait beyond old deadline.

tests.conditions: One real overnight session; battery recorded
tests.expectedBehaviour: Documented heuristic pause and recovery; no claim of physiological detection
tests.reproductionSteps: Record start, predicted/actual pause, fade duration, saved position, battery before/after and interruptions; do not infer unmeasured sleep onset.

tests.conditions: Offline follow; restart; reconnect; then unfollow
tests.expectedBehaviour: Local follow survives; latest-three eligible preparation reconciles; stale work cannot refollow
tests.reproductionSteps: Follow offline; restart; reconnect and inspect status; unfollow during reconciliation; restart; confirm saved/history survive.

tests.conditions: Existing authorised READY and PARTIAL_READY episodes
tests.expectedBehaviour: Brief/chapters/topics/moments/search available; genuine coverage; timestamps play
tests.reproductionSteps: Open ready episode; inspect all features; query known phrase; play reference; repeat partial-ready episode and record coverage label.

tests.conditions: Eligible processing job already running; network interruption
tests.expectedBehaviour: Ready result appears automatically; queued/rights/failure shown truthfully
tests.reproductionSteps: Observe existing queued/preparing episode to completion without repeated Analyse; disconnect/reconnect; inspect restricted episode explanation.

tests.feature: Later seek wins over old sleep record
tests.conditions: Build 14 containing Phase 3 fix required
tests.expectedBehaviour: Later manual seek survives immediate restart
tests.reproductionSteps: After completed sleep, seek elsewhere then immediately restart before five-second periodic save; confirm newer position.

tests.conditions: Build 14 containing Phase 3 diagnostics required
tests.expectedBehaviour: Off by default; bounded local events; safe export; clear/restart removes capture
tests.reproductionSteps: Settings → Report a problem → Start diagnostic capture; exercise playback/skip/sleep; Export; inspect only timing fields; stop and restart; confirm cleared.
